title: DOM modify karo — text changes simulate karo
solution:
let pageText = "Welcome to our website"
pageText = pageText.replace("Welcome", "Hello")
console.log(pageText)
const upperText = pageText.toUpperCase()
console.log(upperText)
const wordCount = pageText.split(" ").length
console.log(wordCount)
pageText = ">> " + pageText
console.log(pageText)
const truncated = pageText.length > 15 ? pageText.slice(0, 15) + "..." : pageText
console.log(truncated)

tests.expected:
Hello to our website
HELLO TO OUR WEBSITE
4
>> Hello to our website
>> Hello to ou...

hints: replace() se ek word doosre se badal sakte ho
Word count: split(" ").length — spaces se words alag karo aur count lo
Truncation: slice(0, 15) + "..." — condition lagao ki length zyada hai to kaato
